title: Jim Abbott
source: Lesson 5 / Listen and Speak 1 B / p.86

units.speaker: A
units.text: Jiho, what are you reading?

units.speaker: B
units.text: I'm reading a book about a baseball player named Jim Abbott.

units.speaker: A
units.text: Oh, the man who was born without a right hand?

units.speaker: B
units.text: That's right. He tried really hard and even won the MVP award.

units.speaker: A
units.text: Yeah. His story was made into a movie. I'm going to watch it this Saturday.

units.speaker: B
units.text: Really? What's the title?

units.speaker: A
units.text: Our Hero. I'm really looking forward to watching it.

units.speaker: B
units.text: Can I join you?

units.speaker: A
units.text: Sure. See you on Saturday.

title: Singing Contest
source: Lesson 5 / Listen and Speak 2 B / p.87

units.speaker: A
units.text: Alex, I'm going to take part in a singing contest next Monday.

units.speaker: B
units.text: That's great, Sumin!

units.speaker: A
units.text: You know how to play the guitar, right?

units.speaker: B
units.text: Yes, I've played the guitar for 3 years.

units.speaker: A
units.text: Great. Can you play the guitar while I sing in the contest?

units.speaker: B
units.text: I'd love to, but I can't. I hurt my hand in gym class yesterday.

units.speaker: A
units.text: Oh! I'm sorry to hear that.

units.speaker: B
units.text: Thanks. But I'll be there to cheer for you.

units.speaker: A
units.text: Hi, Tony! What are you going to do this weekend?

units.speaker: B
units.text: I'm going to watch the musical, Billy Elliot.

units.speaker: A
units.text: Billy Elliot? What is it about?

units.speaker: B
units.text: It's about a boy who became a famous dancer. I'm looking forward to watching it.

units.speaker: A
units.text: Sounds interesting. Who is the main actor?

units.speaker: B
units.text: Jason Kim. He's a great dancer.

units.speaker: A
units.text: He's my favorite actor. I watched his musical last year.

units.speaker: B
units.text: Oh, really? Do you want to join me?

units.speaker: A
units.text: I'd love to, but I can't. I have volunteer work this weekend.

units.speaker: B
units.text: Okay. Maybe next time!

title: Folk Village
source: Lesson 6 / Listen and Speak 1 B / p.104

units.speaker: A
units.text: Sumin, my train is leaving in five minutes.

units.speaker: B
units.text: I hope you enjoyed your trip, Daniel.

units.speaker: A
units.text: Of course, I did.

units.speaker: B
units.text: Which place did you like most in my town?

units.speaker: A
units.text: I liked the folk village most.

units.speaker: B
units.text: Yeah, it's the most popular place here.

units.speaker: A
units.text: I really liked walking around in hanbok. I looked really cool.

units.speaker: B
units.text: I'm glad to hear that.

units.speaker: A
units.text: Thank you for showing me around.

units.speaker: B
units.text: It was my pleasure. Have a safe trip.

title: Concert Tickets
source: Lesson 6 / Listen and Speak 2 B / p.105

units.speaker: A
units.text: The tickets for the World Music Concert are on sale now.

units.speaker: B
units.text: Really? Let's book the tickets online right away.

units.speaker: A
units.text: Okay. Let's see... There are still tickets left for November 5th.

units.speaker: B
units.text: Sounds good. Let's get two student tickets.

units.speaker: A
units.text: Oh, do you mind if I bring my little brother?

units.speaker: B
units.text: Not at all. But it says that you are not allowed to bring children under 8.

units.speaker: A
units.text: No problem. He's 10.

units.speaker: B
units.text: Okay, I'll add one child ticket. The total price is 25 dollars.

units.speaker: A
units.text: Great.

units.speaker: B
units.text: I can't wait to see the concert!

units.speaker: W
units.text: Hello, students! Thank you for visiting our art museum.

units.speaker: W
units.text: This museum opened in 1995.

units.speaker: W
units.text: Since then, it has exhibited many famous artworks.

units.speaker: W
units.text: Today, you will see some famous artworks from the art books.

units.speaker: W
units.text: Before we begin the tour, let me remind you of a basic rule.

units.speaker: W
units.text: You can take pictures of the artworks, but you're not allowed to touch them.

units.speaker: W
units.text: Now let's start the tour.

This museum opened in 1995.
Since then, it has exhibited many famous artworks.

Before we begin the tour,
let me remind you of a basic rule.
You can take pictures of the artworks,
but you're not allowed to touch them.
Now let's start the tour.

title: Baby Penguins
source: Lesson 7 / Listen and Speak 1 B / p.122

units.speaker: A
units.text: Look at the baby penguins on TV. They're so cute.

units.speaker: B
units.text: Yes, but they look very cold out there.

units.speaker: A
units.text: Yeah, the South Pole is the coldest place on Earth.

units.speaker: B
units.text: I wonder how cold it is there.

units.speaker: A
units.text: The average temperature is about −58℃ in July and −26℃ in December.

units.speaker: B
units.text: Oh, then, July is colder than December there. Interesting!

units.speaker: A
units.text: Yes. Although it's very cold there, it doesn't snow much.

units.speaker: B
units.text: That's interesting, too!

title: Namsan Hiking
source: Lesson 7 / Listen and Speak 2 B / p.123

units.speaker: A
units.text: Sumin, what are you going to do on Sunday?

units.speaker: B
units.text: I'm going to go hiking. Do you want to join me?

units.speaker: A
units.text: I'd love to. Where do you want to go?

units.speaker: B
units.text: I'm thinking of going to Namsan.

units.speaker: A
units.text: Oh, the scenery there is so beautiful this time of year.

units.speaker: B
units.text: Right. I heard that it's covered with red autumn leaves now.

units.speaker: A
units.text: Great. How long does the shortest hiking course take?

units.speaker: B
units.text: The Internet says it takes about two hours.

units.speaker: A
units.text: Okay, see you on Sunday!

units.speaker: A
units.text: Let's find out on the Internet.

units.speaker: B

units.text: Wow, that's amazing! Camels are really interesting animals.

units.speaker: B
units.text: I want to travel with them in the desert someday.
